asset: Drive › Stickman Moments – Olaoluwa Michael › With Verse › 090-still-waiting.png
caption:
TITLE: Still Waiting
CATEGORY: Faith Stirring

Waiting is not the absence of God.
It is the classroom of God.

You prayed for the job.
You prayed for the spouse.
You prayed for the child, the visa, the breakthrough.
And you are still waiting.

People around you are moving.
Their testimonies are coming.
Your phone is quiet.

“The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.” Lamentations 3:25

Notice that it doesn't say He is good to those who receive quickly.
He is good to them that wait.

Abraham waited.
Hannah waited.
Joseph waited in a prison he didn't deserve.
And not one of them waited in vain.

So while you are waiting, don't stop seeking.
Waiting without seeking makes you bitter.
Waiting while seeking makes you ready.

Your waiting is not wasted.
It is just not finished yet. 🤍

asset: Drive › Stickman Moments – Olaoluwa Michael › With Verse › 078-nobody-liked-my-post.png
caption:
TITLE: Nobody Liked My Post
CATEGORY: Reflections

You posted it.
You checked after five minutes.
Two likes. One is your mum. 😅
You checked again after an hour.
Still two.

And something in you whispered, “Nobody cares about what you do.”

I know that feeling.
As a creator, I have posted things I prayed over that nobody noticed.

But then I read Paul:
“For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.” Galatians 1:10

The algorithm is not your audience.
God is.

Likes measure reach.
They don't measure worth.
And they definitely don't measure obedience.

If God told you to write it, sing it or build it, then post it and let it go.
Some seeds grow slowly.
Some seeds are watered by one person you will never meet.

So keep posting. Keep obeying.
Heaven sees what the timeline ignores. 🤍

asset: text only
caption:
TITLE: Why I Build With AI (As a Christian Creative)
CATEGORY: Reflections

Some people ask me, “Michael, is it right for a Christian to use AI?”

Let me answer the way I understand it.

The tool is not the message.
The pen didn't write Romans. Paul did, with a pen.
The printing press didn't save anybody. But it put the Bible in people's hands.

I use AI the same way.
To draw stickman stories faster.
To design cards for films that preach.
To build apps like Bible Arena, so young people can enjoy the Word.

But the faith is not artificial.
The prayer is not generated.
The message still has to come from God, through a person who has walked with Him.

So yes, I build with AI.
And everything I build has one goal:
to leave people closer to Jesus. 🤍

30 days ago, I told you God was doing a new thing. 🥹
Look at Him.

*“I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.”* Psalm 116:1

Take a moment today and write down one prayer He answered this month.
Even a small one.
Especially a small one.

Gratitude is how we remember that He heard us. 🙏

Share your testimony with one person today. Let's celebrate God together.

Is there no balm in Gilead? 🥹

There is a quiet epidemic no hospital treats.
Depression. Trauma. Unfair suffering.
People smiling in church and breaking at home.

I wrote Balm of Gilead for them.
And for the healers among us who don't even know they are healing anybody.

Over 350 people have downloaded it from my site. It's free 👇
https://olaoluwamichael.vercel.app/books/balm-of-gilead

Send it to someone who is quietly carrying something heavy. 🤍
